question: Do physical features and axial mixing improve ink ranking on a new segment at matched optimizer steps and inference?
test_window_selection: Maximum supervision-mask coverage on a 128-pixel grid; test ink values and model outputs not used.
test_policy: Open test after all checkpoints and validation thresholds are frozen. No polarity selection or registration tuning on test.
normalization: Central 16 native-depth slices; canonical Z orientation; global valid-volume z-score and mask-normalized 129-pixel planar drift subtraction, clipped to [-3.5,3.5].
loss: Identical FableLoss BCE+Tversky for all variants; no teacher labels, no synthetic ink, no fiber penalty.
p800_policy: Exploratory unlabeled crop at native 8.64um. Agreement or high score is not independent evidence of ink.
limitation: Small same-scroll segment holdout, two seeds, unequal parameter counts reported explicitly; no claim of cross-scroll accuracy or material identification. 3D geometric overlap between segment surfaces has not been audited.
